text: Lundesdì a i sienziats de la Stanford University School of Medicine a i han nonziad ‘l invenzion de un nœv strument diagnostic qe ‘l pœ tœr fœra i cellulle par tipollojia: un microcip picinin qe ‘l pœ vesser fait su cond una stampant a jet de incioster standard par de plu o de manc de un centesim de dollar american.
eng_text: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: A i ricercador qe a i dirijen ol projet a i g’ha diit qe çò ‘l poderia portar a descovir ol cancer, la tubercollos, HIV e la mallaria ind pazients qe a i viven i pais pover, indove la percentualla de spere de soraviver a mai coma ‘l cancer a ‘l sen ‘l pœ vesser meza de qella de pazients qe i viven in pais plussé reç.
eng_text: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

eng_text: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: La protesta ‘l é ninzada circa a i 11:00 de ‘l ora localla (UTC+1) a Whitehall, deprœv a l’entrada sorveiada de la pollizia de Downing Street, la residenza ufiçalla dol Prim Minister.
eng_text: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

eng_text: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

eng_text: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Invers a i 11:29 la protesta la s’é spostada su Whitehall, de illà de Trafalgar Square, arent a ‘l Strand, e l’é passada arent a Aldwych e Kingsway invers a Holborn, indove ol Partid conservador a’l tegniva ol Forum de Prumavera ind ol Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.
eng_text: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

eng_text: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

eng_text: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

eng_text: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

eng_text: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

eng_text: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Vergun a i crèt, e intra qei g’é anca John Grant, qe la crisis dei finanziaments e anca un cambi ind ela fillosofia de la programazion televisiva qe parla de educazion i a contribuìt a fà finì la serie.
eng_text: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Segond a i meterollog, g’é la possibillitaa qe la tompesta, qe la se trova a circa 645 miglie (1040 km) a ovest dei isle de Cap Verd, la sa desfante inanz de menaçar un area terrestre.
eng_text: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

eng_text: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

eng_text: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

eng_text: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, copillota dol team A1GP Nœva Zellanda, incœ ‘l g’ha fait la storia cond la sò guida plussé sperta in su ‘l pont de 48 agn dol port de Auckland in manera legalla.
eng_text: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Ol sior Reid ‘l g’é ruvad a guidar la maqina dol A1GP Nœva Zellanda, Black Beauty, a una vellocitaa sora de 160 km/h par set vœlte in su ‘l pont.
eng_text: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: La pollizia de la Nœva Zellanda la g’ha duzud sbogiar-s a doprar a i sò radar de vellocitaa par veger a quant qe ‘l ira dre a nar ol sior Reid par la basseza de Black Beauty; la solla vœlta qe la pollizia la g’é ruvada a signar la vellocitaa dol sior Reid ‘l é stait quand qe ‘l g’ha rallentad jo fina a I 160 km/h.
eng_text: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Ind ei dredegn 3 mis, plussé de 80 prexoner a i henn lassads nar de la Central Booking facility sensa qe i sien staits acusads in manera formalla.
eng_text: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Ind ol avril de qell ann qi, ol jugg Glynn ‘l g’ha mandad fœra un orden de restrizion contra la strutura par imponir ol rillassament de qi qe a i henn staits tegnuds illò plussé de 24 ore de quand qe a i henn staits ciapads e qe a i hann gnemò vud una udienza dol comissare dol tribunall.
eng_text: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Ol commissari fissa la cauzion, se daita, e ‘l formalliza i acuse qe i vegnen daite dol ufiçall qe ‘l aresta. I acuse a i vegnen doncà metude dent ind ol sistema informatic statall indove ‘l cas a ‘l ven traçad.
eng_text: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: A’l udienza la marca pò anc la data par ol dricc dol sospetad a un process spert.
eng_text: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, tesorer austraian e ‘l òm qe probablement ‘l serà despò de John Howard ‘l leader dol partit liberall, ‘l g’ha dait ol sò suport a ‘l industria nucleara in Austraia.
eng_text: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Ol sior Costello ‘l g’ha diit qe quand qe la produzion de enerjia nucleara la divegnerà praticabilla a nivell economic, l’Austraia la g’haria de circar de drovar-la.
eng_text: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: “Se la vegn começalla, g’hariem de vir-la. Vœi dir, par principe g’é nuguna obiezion a l’enerjia nucleara” ‘l g’ha diit Costello.
eng_text: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Segond l’Ansa “la pollizia ‘l ira preocupada par un per de s’ciopedade a nivell sosen volt e la g’hiva pagura qe çò ‘l pœdia fa s’ciopar una vira guera de sucession.
eng_text: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

eng_text: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

eng_text: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

eng_text: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Ol Brasill ‘l é ‘l plussé grand pais catolic roman in su la Tera e la Cesa Catollica Romana la g’ha semper fait contra a la legallizazion dol sposalleze intra persone cond ol istes ses.
eng_text: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Ol Congres Nazionall dol Brasill ‘l g’ha dibatud in su la legallizazion par 10 agn e cotai sposalleze civiii a i henn essessa legai nomà ind ol Rio Grande do Sul.
eng_text: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: La propòsta de lex orijinalla ‘l é stait scrivud jo dol ex sindec de San Paolo, Marta Suplicy. La propòsta de lex, despò vesser staita modificada, ‘l é or ind ei man de Roberto Jefferson.
eng_text: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: A i manifestants a i speren de vir-g una petizion de 1,2 miion de firme da presentar a ‘l Congres Nazionall a november.
eng_text: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Despò qe ‘l é divegnud ciar patòc qe tante famiie a i heren dre a circar un’ aida legalla par far contra a i sfrattaments, ol 20 marz ‘l s’é tegnud una riunion ind ol East Bay Community Law Center par i vitime dei ingagn su i cà.
eng_text: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Quand qe i abitants in afit a i g’han comenzad a condivider qell qe g’ira frontad a lor, la plu banda dei famiie ciapade dent ind ella situazion la s’é debòta incurxuda qe Carolyn Wilson de l’OHA la g’heva rubad a i lor deposits de cauzion e ‘l ira fœbiada vià de la citaa.
eng_text: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Qi qe i viven i afit a Lockwood Gardens a i creden qe pœderia ves-g oltre 40 famiie o plussé qe ‘l é g’ha de far contra a ‘l sfrat, siend qe i g’hann apredud qe la pollizia de l’Oha ‘l é dre intrequerir pò anc su oltre proprietaa de edillizia residenzialla in Oakland qe i pœderien vesser ciapade dent ind ol ingan imobilliar.
eng_text: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: A i famos avocads grecc, Sakis Kechagioglou e George Nikolakopoulos a I henn staits imprexunads ind ol cacer de Aten de Korydallus, parqè a i hen staits jugiads colpevoi de trufa e coruzion.
eng_text: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

eng_text: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

eng_text: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

eng_text: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts a ‘l g’ha refudad dol tut de dir quand qe ‘l cres qe la vita la comenze, una domanda importanta quand qe ‘l se considera ‘l etica dol abòrt, e l g’ha diit qe ‘l saria minga etic comentar i specifiqe dei cas probabii.
eng_text: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Anc’isseben, ‘l g’ha ribadid la sò precedent afermazion qe Roe v. Wade l’ira la “lex stabill ind ol pais”e sotollinead l’importanza de sentenze coerente de la Cort Suprema.
eng_text: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: A ‘l g’ha pò anc confermad de creder ind ol dricc implicid a la privacy de indova dipendeva la decision de Roe.
eng_text: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

eng_text: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

eng_text: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

eng_text: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Qest ravaç dol tut cond i piume e cond ol sangu cold ‘l se crediva qe ‘l caminaves dricc in su i sgerle cond ei raspe com qelle dol Velociraptor.
eng_text: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Ol Dotor Lee ‘l g’ha anc esprimud preocupazion par i notizie dixen i bagai in Turqia a i henn staits infetads dol virus de la inflenza aviaria A(H5N1) sensa malar-s.
eng_text: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text: A’l g’ha sotollinead qe vergun studi a i par dimostrar qe un mal ol g’ha de diventar demanc letall inanz de pœdir causar un’epidemia globalla.
eng_text: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

text: A g’é pagura qe i pazient a i pœderian sœtar a infetar plu persone ind ol far i lor lavor de tuts i dì se i sintom de l’influenza a i henn linjer.
eng_text: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Leslie Aun, portavox de la Komen Foundation, la g’ha diit qe l'organizazion la g’ha adotad una nœv regol qe la lassa minga conceder sovenzion o finanziaments a organizazion qe a i henn sota inquisizion legalla.
eng_text: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: La policy de Komen la g’ha desquallificad Planned Parenthood par un'indajin in sospes in su coma Planned Parenthood la spend e la signalla i diner qe i vegnen condoxuds dol representant Cliff Stearns.
eng_text: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Stearns ‘l é dre qe indaga se i tasse i sien dovrade par finanziar i abòrts a travers ol Planned Parenthood ind ol sò roll coma president de la Sotacomission par la Suravisione e i Ingajin, qe ‘l é sota ‘l contròll de la Commssion par l'Enerjia e il Comerç.
eng_text: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: A’l ex governador dol Massachusetts Mitt Romney ‘l g’ha vençud mardì i ellezion primarie presidenzialle dol Partit Republican de la Florida con plussé dol 46 percent dei vòts.
eng_text: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: A’l ex president de la Cambra dei Stats Units Newt Gingrich ‘l é arivad segond cond ol 32 percent.
eng_text: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Siend qe ‘l é un stat indove ‘l vencidor a’l ciapa tut, la Florida la g’ha daits tuts i so cinquanta representants a Romney e çò ‘l a sponciad a’l cò a la nomination dol Partito Republican.
eng_text: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: I organizador de la protesta i hann diit qe circa 100.000 persone a i henn venude a protestar in cittaa todesqe coma Berlin, Collogna, Amburg e Hannover.
eng_text: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: A Berlin la polizia la g’ha stimad qe a i g’eren 6500 protestadœr.
eng_text: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: A g’é staite di proteste pœ anc a Paris, a Sofia in Bulgaria, a Vilnius in Lituania, a Valeta in Malta, a Tallin in Estonia, a Edinburg e a Glasgow in Scozia.
eng_text: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: #REF!
eng_text: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: El mis passat a i g’henn staite de le grósse proteste in Polonia quand qe qell pais a‘l g’ha firmad jó el ACTA. Qesta decizion la g’ha portad ‘l govern de la Polnia a cerner de minga ratificar ‘l accordi per adess.
eng_text: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: La Letonia e la Slovaqia le g’ha tute e do ritardàt i procedure per nar dent ind el ACTA.
eng_text: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Animall Liberation e la Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) a i domanda torna ‘l installazion de tellecamere a circuit serrad ind tuts i matatore austraian.
eng_text: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: ‘L ispetor qe ‘l comanda la RSPCA dol New South Wales David O'Shannessy ‘l g’ha diit a ‘lABC qe la sorveianza e i ispezion dei matatore a ‘l g’haria de vesser un ròb comun in Austraia.
eng_text: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: “La CCTV daria de sugur un ciar signall a qelle persone qe lavoren cond i animai in su qe ‘l benessere dei bestie ‘l é la massima prioritaa.”
eng_text: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: La mapa di teramòtt internaziunàl de la societa geologeca di Stat Ünii la mustra qe dent a l’ültima semàna gh’en stà mia de teramòtt in Islànda.
eng_text: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: L’ufizi meteurulògic de l’Islànda l’ha mia ripurtà nissun teramòtt dent 48 ur nel sit ciamà Hekla.
eng_text: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: El teramòtt doerïa vès stà sü la cima de la bùca del vulcàn a nort est, el 10 de marz, inscì fort da causà üna növa faas.
eng_text: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: A vàl gh’eran nìvol scür qe però ieren mia legà al müimènt tel vulcàn.
eng_text: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: I nìvol i fasivan dumò cunfüsiun per capì se l’era vèra qe gh’era stada ün’eruziùn.
eng_text: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Ol Luno ‘l g’heva a bord 120-160 meter cub de carburant quand ‘l s é rompud, g’era tant vent e i onde a i ‘l ha sponciad decontra dol franjifluts.
eng_text: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: I ellicoter a i han aidad i dodes member dol eqipaj e la solla ferita ‘l é stait un nas sqies.
eng_text: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: La nav de 100 meter ‘l ira in rota par tœr la sò carga usualla de fertillizants e in prumera i funzionari a i g’heven pora qe la nave la pœdie stravacar la carga.
eng_text: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: A’l emendament proponud ‘l é jemò stait aprovad de tute e do i Camere ind ol 2011.
eng_text: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Una modifica ‘l é staita faita in qesta sessione legislativa quand qe la segonda sentenza ‘l é staita scancellada inanz de la Camera dei representants e pœ ‘l é passada in una forma similla lunesdì dol Senat.
eng_text: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Ol falliment de la seconda sentenza, qe propon de inibir i union civii intra persone dol medem ses, poderia fòrs derver la strava a i union civii ind ol futur.
eng_text: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Dòp ‘l proces, HJR-3 ‘l sarà torna esaminad de la legislatura qe vegnerà ellejuda ind ol 2015 o ind ol 2016 per restar ind ol proces.
eng_text: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: I suces de Vautier a ‘l de fœra de la regia includen un dejun ind ol 1973 contra qella qe ‘l considerava coma censura pollitica.
eng_text: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: La lex francesa ‘l é staita modificda. Ol sò ativism ‘l é comenzad a l’etaa de 15 agn quand qe ‘l s’é unid a la Resistenza francesa durant la segonda guera mondialla.
eng_text: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: A’l g’ha contad su de la sò vita ind un liber dol 1998.
eng_text: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Ind ei agn '60 ‘l é tornad in Algeria, da poc indipendenta, par insegnar regia cinematografica.
eng_text: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: A’l é mórt a l'età de 54 agn ‘l judoka japones Hitoshi Saito, vencidor de do medaie d'or ollimpiche.
eng_text: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Ol motiv de la mórt é staita nonziada vesser ol canqer dol dot billiar intraepatic.
eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: A’l é mórt mardì a Osaka.
eng_text: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Insema a vesser un ex campion olimpic e mondiall, Saito ‘l ira ‘l president dol comitat de adestrament de la All Japan Judo Federation a ‘l moment de la sò mórt.
eng_text: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: A la festa g’heven ciapad part olmanc 100 persone par cellebrar ol prim anniversari de una copia qe la s’ira sposada ‘l ann passat.
eng_text: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Un event formall per ‘l anniversari ‘l é stait programad par una data seguenta, a i g’han diit i funzionari.
eng_text: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: La copia la s’ira sposada in Texas un an indre e l’ira vegnuda a Buffalo par festejar cond ei sò amiç e parents.
eng_text: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Ol marid, 30 agn e nassud a Buffalo, ‘l é stait vunn dei quarter mazads ind ella sparatoria, mò la moer a’l é minga staita ferida.
eng_text: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno ‘l é cognossud de tants e controvers un professor de lingua inglesa qe ‘l g’ha insegnad a Modern Education e a King’s Glory qe ‘l g’ha diit de avir 9.000 students a’l massim de la sò carriera.
eng_text: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Ind i sò appunts ‘l g’ha drovad parolle qe vergun rejur a i reputen volgare e, segond qell qe ‘l é stait diit, ‘l g’ha drovad brute parolle in clas.
eng_text: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education a’l l’ha acusad de stampar jó grande publicita in su i autobus sensa autorizazion e de mentir quand qe ‘l dis qe ‘l ira sora de tut un tutor de ingles.
eng_text: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Inanz ‘l ira stait pò anc acusad de viollazion dol copyright, mò ‘l é minga stait processad.
eng_text: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un ex student ‘l g’ha diit qe “a’l drovava ‘l slang in clas, ‘l dava consei su i apuntaments ind ei apunts e ‘l ira dolbon coma ‘l amiç dei students.”
eng_text: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Ind ei dredegne dexene de agn, anc’isseben ‘l sie anc’mò un pais comunista, la Cina la g’ha desvellopad una economia de mercad.
eng_text: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: I prime riforme economiqe a i henn staite faite sota la guida de Deng Xiaoping.
eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: De illora, la dimension economica de la Cina ‘l é cressuda de 90 vœlte.
eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Par la prima vœlta, l’an passad la Cina la g’ha esportad plussé automobii de la Jermania e la ha superad i Stats Units.
eng_text: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Ol PIL de la Cina ‘l pœderia vesser plussé grand qe qell dei Stats Units intra vint agn.
eng_text: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: La tompesta tropicalla Danielle, la quarta tompesta qe la g’ha vud nòm ind ella seson dei uragan atlantic dol 2010, ‘l s’é fait su ind ol Ocean Atlantic orientall.
eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: La tompesta, qe la sa trova a circa 3.000 miia de Miami, in Florida, la g’ha una vellocitaa de vents massim sostenud de 40 miglia a l’ora(64 qillomenter a l’ora).
eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: A i sienziats a ‘l National Hurricane Center a i preveden qe Danielle ‘l se raforzerà fina a divegnir un uragan par mercordì.
eng_text: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Parqè la tompesta ‘l é dellonj dol apròd, ‘l resta malfar valludar ol potenziall impat in su i Stats Units o in su i Caraibi.
eng_text: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Nassud ind ella capitalla croata, Zagabria, Bobek ‘l é divegnud famos quand qe ‘l g’ha jugad par il Partizan Belgrad.
eng_text: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: A’l s’é unid a lor ind ol 1945 e ‘l é rimanud fina a ‘l 1958.
eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Durant ‘l temp qe ‘l g’ha jugad cond ella squadra l’ g’ha fait 403 gòll in 468 partide.
eng_text: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Nugun de olter ‘l g’ha mai fait plussé partide o fait plussé gòl par ol club qe Bobek.
eng_text: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Ind ol 1995 a ‘l é stait votad coma ‘l meior jugador ind ella storia dol Partizan.
eng_text: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: A i cellebrazion a i henn comenzade cond un spetacòll speçall dol grup de nomnanza mondialla Cirque du Soleil.
eng_text: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: A l’é staita seguida de la Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, una band de Janiser, e dai cantor Fatih Erkoç e Müslüm Gürses.
eng_text: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Despò a i henn naits in su ‘l palc a i Whirling Dervishes.
eng_text: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: La diva turca Sezen Aksu la s’é esibida cond ol tenor itaian Allessander Safina e ol cantor grec Haris Alexiou.
eng_text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: A la fin, ol grupp de ball turc Fire of Anatolia ‘l g’ha ballad ol spetacòll “Troy”.
eng_text: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, un motociclista de 13 agn, ‘l é mórt dòp vesser stait ciapad dent ind un incident a ‘l circuit de maqine de Indianapolis.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Ind ol sò jir fait par riscoldar-s, Lenz ‘l é borlad jó de la sò moto e ‘l é pœ stait ciapad dent de ‘l sò compar de corsa Xavier Zayat.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: A’l é stait debòta tendud dol personall medic qe ‘l sta aprœv a la pista e trasportad ind un ospedall locall indova pœ ‘l é mórt.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat a’l s’é minga fait mal ind ol incident.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Zapatero ‘l é nait inanz a di de la situazion finanziaria mondialla qe “ol sistema finanziari ‘l é una part de l’econimia, una parta centralla.
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: G’havom una crisi finanziaria de un an, qe la g’ha avud ol sò moment plussé grèv ind ei dredegn mis, e crese qe ora i mercad finanziare a sie dre a repollar-s”.
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: La semana passada, Naked News ‘l g’ha nonziad qe ‘l aumenterà grandement ol sò mandat linguistic internazionall par i notiziari, con trè nœve trasmission.
eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Jemò con notiziari in ingles e japones, l’organizazion globalla ‘l é dre a lançar program in spagnœll, itaian e corean par la tellevision, ol web e par i dispositiv mobii.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Par fortuna ‘l m’é capitad negota, ma g’ho vist una sena macabra, beneman qe i persone i circaven de sqiessa i fenestre par nar fœra.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: I persone a i colpiven i veder con i cadrege, ma i fenestre a i eren de qelle qe ‘l sa pœ minga rompir.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: “Vunn dei veder a la fenestra ‘l s’é rompid e la jent la g’ha tecad a nar fœra de la finestra”, ‘l g’ha diit ol soravissud Franciszek Kowal.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: A i stee a i fan lux e callor par ‘l enerjia prodoxuda quand qe i atom de idroger a i henn mes’ciads (o fundids) insema par far su ellements plussé pisants.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: A i sienziats a i henn dre a lavorar par la creazion de un reator bon de prodoxir enerjia ind ella istessa manera.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Qest, però, ‘l é un problema dificil fes de risolver e a i ga vœleran tants agn inanz de veder costruiti reator a fusion qe a i fonzionen.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: La gucia de açall la sta su in su l’aiva par la tension superfiçalla.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: La tension superfiçalla la g’é parqè i mollecolle d’aiva in su la superfis de l’aiva a i henn trade fes ‘l una de l’oltra plussé qe a i lo sien dei mollecolle d’aria de sora de lore.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: I mollecolle d’aiva a i fann su una pell invisibla in su la superfis de l’avia qe permet a ròb coma una gucia de star su de sura de l’aiva.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: La lama de un patin de giaç modern la g’ha un dopi bòrd cond una cavitaa concava intra de lor. A i do bords a permet de sta plussé tecads al giaç, infina quand qe ‘l é inclinad.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Siend qe la parta inferiora de la lama ‘l é un pitinin curva, parqè la lama la se inclina de una banda o de un oltra, pò anc ol bòrd qe ‘l é in contant cond ol giaç ‘l s’é curva.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Çò ‘l va voltar ol patinador. Se i patin a se inclinen a dricia, ol patinador a ‘l volta a dricia, se i patin a se inclinen a stòrta, ol patinador a ‘l volta a stròrta.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Par tornar a ‘l nivell de enerjia de inanz, a i g’han de livrar-s dol enerjia extra qe a i g’han otegnud de la lux.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: A i lo fan mandand fœra una particella picinina de lux ciamada “foton”.
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: A i sienziats ciamen qest process qi “emission stimollada de radiazion” parqè a i atom a i henn stimollats de la lux intensa, çò ‘l provoca l’emission de un foton de lux, e la lux ‘l é una tipollojia de radiazion.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: L’imajin qe la ven despò la fa veder a i atom qe a i manden fœra foton. Oviament in realtaa a i foton a i henn tant plussé picegn qe ind ella imajin.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: A i foton a i henn infina plussé picegn dei ròb qe i fann su a i atom!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Despò de centiner de ore qe la va ol fillament de la lampadina a i se bruxa e la lampadina la funziona plu.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: La lampadina la g’ha doncà de vesser cambiada. A’l se g’ha de metir-g œgg ind ella sostituzion de la lampadina.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Inanz qe tut, a’l sa g’ha de smorzar l’interutor de la lux o descollegar ol cav.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Quest ‘l sa g’ha de far-l parqè l’elletricitaa qe la va dent ind ella presa indove la sa trova la parta de metall de la lampadina la pœ dar-t una possant shock elletric se ta toqe ol dedent de la presa o ol çoc metallic de la lampadina quand qe ‘l é anc’mò in part ind ella presa.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: A ‘l orgen principall dol sistema cicollatore ‘l é ‘l cœr qe ‘l pompa ‘l sangu.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Ol sangu ‘l va vià dol cœr ind ei tub ciamads arterie e ‘l torna indré ind ei tub ciamads vene. A i tubixin plu picegn a i henn ciamads capillar
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: I dénc den triceratop pòdeven schiscià mia dumò i föj ma anca ràm e radìs parécc dür.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Ghè di scienziàà che i pénsen che i Triceratop majaven cicadii, chi ienn na tipologìa de plànta difundìda in tel Cretaceu.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Sti plànti parèn na pàlma pinìna cont na coròna di föj precis e güz.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Pò véss che un Triceratop duperàva el sò bècch per scarpà via i föj prima de majà al tronch.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Olter scienziàà i pénsen inveci che sti plànti i eren velenus donca l’è propri mia inscì pussìbil che i dinosàuri i majavén, siben incö g’ha el bradìp e olter animai cuma ‘l papagàl (discendènt di dinosàuri) chi pòden majà föj e früta velenus.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: La gravità de Io, cuma la agiréss su de mì? Si te füs su la superfix de Io, te pesarès ménu che sü la Tèra.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Na persòna che la pésa 200 paunt (90kg) sü la Tèra, la pesarés adree 36 paunt (16kg) sü l’Io. Donca l’è ciàr che l’efèt de la gravità l’è mia inscì forte.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: El suu g’ha mia de crùsta cuma la Tèra ‘ndua te pòdet stà in pè. El suu l’è per intreg fàcc de gas, fööch e plàsma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: El gas el diventa püssè fin püssè te se luntanèt del center del suu.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: La part estèrna che vedum quand en vàrda ‘l suu l’è ciamàda fotosféra, che el vö dir “bàla de lüs”.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Dopu trimila ann, in tel 1610, l’astrònom italiàn Galileo Galilei l’ha duperò un telescòpi per usarvär che Véner g’aveva di fàas propi cuma la lüna.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: I fàas i ghen dumò parchè el lato de Véner (ò de la Lüna) che ‘l ciapa ‘l suu l’è Iluminaa. I fàas de Véner i suportén la teorìa del Copernicus che i pianét i van inturno al suu.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Pö, un quai an dopu in tel 1639, un astrònom inglés ciamàà Jeremiah Horrocks l’ha uservaa il transet de Véner.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: L’Inghiltèra l’ha vivüü en bel mument de paas dopu la reconquista del Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Ma in tel 991 Ethelred l’era andà incontra a na flòtta Vichinga che l’era pussee grande de quela di Gutrhum, un sècol prima.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Sta flòtta l’era guidàda da Olaf Tryfvasson, en nurveges qe l’ghera ambiziun de riclamär el sò pais da la dominazion danes.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Dopo de problemi militari al prenzépe, Ethelred l’era stait bun de acurdáss cun Olaf, qe l’erà turnà in Nurvegia per tentar de guadagnär el sò règn cun divers success.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul l’è l’ünic abecee inventaa de proposìt per l’üs popular de tücc i dì. L’abecee l’era sta inventaa in tel 1444 lung el règn del Rè Sejong (1418-1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: El Rè Sejong l’era el quart rè de la dinastìa Joseon e l’è vün di püssé aprezaa.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Origenariament l’abecee Hangeul l’era ciamaa Hunmin Jeongeum, che ‘l vör dì “i rumùr giüst per l’istruziùn de la gént”.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Ghà parécc teurii de l’origìn del Sanscrìt. Vüna di quele la parla de ‘na migraziùn ariàna de l’ovèst a l’India che la gavarés purtaa la lùr lengua.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: El Sanscrit l’è ‘na lengua antiga e l’è cumparabìl al Latin che l’era parlaa in Europa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: El primm liber cognossuu in tel mùnd l’era staa scrivuu in Sanscrit. Dopu la cumpilaziùn de l’Upanishads, el Sanscrit l’era sparii a càusa di gerarchii.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: El Sanscrit l’era propri ‘na lengua cumplessa e rica, che l'è servida cuma funt per parécc lengui muderni, compagn del Latin che l’è la funt per i lengui Europei cuma el francés e ‘l spagnö.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Cun la fin de la batàia per la Frància, la Germània l’era tacà a preparàss per invàt l’isùla de Bretàgna.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: La Germània ghera dà a l’atàch el nomm in codès “Operation Sealion”. La grànd part di armi pesaant e reforniment de l’armäda Britanega i eren andà perduu quand l’era scapada de Dunkirk, donca l’armäda l’era pütost fiàca.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ma la Marina Britanega l’era amò püssee forta de la Marina todèsca (“Kriegsmarine”) e la pòdeva dastrügiar ogni flòta de invasiùn che l’era inviada via Canàl Inglés.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Tutavia, dumò en quai naf de la Marina Britanega i stavén visin ai pussíbil zòni de invasiùn perchè i amiràgli gh’eren pagüra che i pòdeven fundà de n’atàch aéreo di todèsch.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Cominciàmo cun la spiegaziün di piàn de l’Itàlia. L’Itàlia l’era püsse che oltru el “fradelìn” de la Germània e del Japòn.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: La g’aveva ün’armäda e üna marina püsse fiàchi, anca se i eren fach sü quàter naf nöf propri prima de l’inìzi de la guèra.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: I obietìf pussè grand de l’Itàlia i eren i paès africàn. Per ciapà quei paès i gh’eren de vèch ‘na bas militàr de lànch, inscì i truppi i pudévan navigär in tel Mar Mediterani per invàd l’Afrìca.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Propi per chèstu, i duvevan desfesciass di bas e naf britaneg in Egìtt. Olter a sti aziùn, i naf de batàia italiàn gheven mia de fà nient’oltru.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Adès el Japòn. Il Japòn l’era un paès insulàr, propri cuma la Gran Bretàgna.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: I sutumarìn ienn naf prugetàà per viagià suta l’aqua e i restén lì per üna grànd quantitaa de temp.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: I sutumarìn i eren duperà in de la Prima Guèra Mundiàl e in de la Segùnda Guèra Mundiàl. Alùra i eren parécc lénti e i ghaveven un rach de tir tànt limitàà.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Al princìpi de la guèra i viagiavén quasi sempar su la superfìss del mar, ma cun tel svilùp di radar chi vegniven sempar pü precìs, i sutumarìn i duvevan per forza andà suta l’aqua per evitär de fass vedè.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: I sutumarìn tòdesch eren ciamàà U-Boats. I tòdesch ieren parècc bun de navigà e doperà i lür sutumarìn.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: A causa del lür sucèss cun ti sutumarìn, dopu la guèra ai todèsch a 'i's g'a mia permitìt ighen'ne trop.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Sì! El Re Tutankhamun, quaivolta ciamàà “King Tut” o “The Boy King”, l’è vün di re püssé cognossuu di antìg Egìzi in temp mudern.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: L’è interessànt cuma l’era mia cunsideraa inscì impurtànt nei temp antig e l’era mia registraa sü la grand part di antig elenc di re.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Tutavia, cun la scuverta de la sò tomba in tel 1922 l’è diventaa famòs. Parécc tombi del passà i eren staa derobà, ma sta tomba l’era restada propi indistürbada.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: La grand pàrt di ojètt seppelii cun Tutankhamun ienn staa ben cunservaa, e gh'eren dent miaia de artefacc fà sü de metai preziùs e pedri rar.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: L’invenziùn di rödi cun ti ràgg l’ha fa deventà i carr di Assiri püssé ligger, püssé svélt e mei preparaa per superà oltri suldàà o carr.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: I frecc di lür balestri murtài podèven andò dent l’armadüra di suldàà rivai. Adree 1000 a.C., i Assiri inventaven la prima cavalerìa.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Üna cavalerìa l’è ün’armada che la cumbatt a cavàl. La sèla l’era stada gnamò inventadà, donca la cavaleria assira la cumbatéva su la schéna biòta di sò cavài.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Cugnùsum parécc politeg, scienziaa e artist grècch. Pò véss che la persòna la püssé cognossuda de sta coltùra l’è Omero, el legendari poeta òrb, che l’era compost dò capolavóri de la leteratüra grèca: i poémi Iliade e Odissea.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofocle e Aristofane ienn ancamò famus dramatùrg e i lür operi ienn cunsideraa tra i püssé grand operi de la leteratüra mundiàl.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Un olter grècch famus l’è el matematego Pitagora, cognossuu püssé per il sò famus teuréma su le relaziùn di lati del triòngolo retàngolo.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: El g’ha divèrs stìm del nümar di persònn chi parlen Hindi. El se stìma che l’è tra la segònda e la quàrta léngua püssee parlada al mond.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: El nümar di maderlengua al càmbia a segònda se en cunta i dialétt stretiament ligaa.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: I stìm i van de 340 miliùn a 500 miliùn de parlancc, e ienn 800 miliùn chi pòdèn capì la léngua.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi e Urdu ienn sìmil in tel vocabolari ma divérs in tel scriit; nei cunversaziùn di tücc i dì, i parlancc di tüti dò léngui i se pòdèn capì l’ün l’olter.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Intorna al XV secùl, el nort de l’Estònia l’era sùta grand influénza colturàl de la Germània.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: On quai mòneg vorevan purtà Dio püssee visìn a la gént natìva, donca ieren inventaa la léngua letéral estòne.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: L’era basàda sun tel abecee tòdesch e l’era staa giontaa el caratér “Õ/õ”.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Cun tel passaa del témp, tànti paroli chi eren staa ciapà in prestìt dal tòdesch si eren unii. Chèsschìi l’era l’inizi de l’iluminaziùn.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Per tradiziùn, l’eréd al tròno gaveva de ‘ndà drizz in de l’ezercìt una vòlta finii la scöla.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Tutavia, Carlo l’era andaa a l’università del Trinity College a Cambridge, ‘ndua l’era studiaa Antrupulugìa e Archeulugìa e in seguit anca Storia cun 2:2 (üna laurea de segunda class inferiùr).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Carlo l’era staa el prim membru de la Famèja Reàl Bretanéga a otegnì üna laurea.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: La Türchia Europèa (Tràcia orientàl o Rumélia in te la penisùla di Balcàn) la cumprènd el 3% del paès.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: El teritòri de la Türchia l’è püssé lòng de 1600 chilòmeter (1000 mi) e püssé làrch de 800 chilòmeter (500 mi), cont üna fùrma quasi retangulàr.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: L'area de la Türchia, cun i làch, la ocùpa 783.562 chilòmeter quadri (300.948 mq), de cui 755.688 chilòmeter quadri (291.773 mq) ienn in de l’Asia sud-ocidentàl e 23.764 chilòmeter quadri (9174 mq) in Euròpa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: La Türchia per la sò area l’è el 37esìm paés püssé grànd del mund, e l’è al’incìrca de la grandèza de la Frància metrupulitàna e del Regn Ünì metù insèma.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: La Türchia l’è circundada di maar sü tri lati: el Mar Egèo a ovést, el Mar Negro a nòrt e il Mar Mediterani a süd.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: El Lüssemburg el g’ha ‘na longa stòria ma la sò indipendènza l’è datada 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: In tel passà i pàrt del Bèlgi d'incö i fasivén pàrt del Lüssemburg ma i eren diventè Bèlgi dopu la Rivoluziùn Bèlga di ann ‘30 del Vòtcént.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: El Lüssemburg l’ha semper pruvà a restà ün paès neutràl ma l’era staa ocüpaa de la Germània lung la Prìma e la Segònda Guéra Mundiàl.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: In tel 1957 el Lüssemburg l’era diventaa ün fundaduu de la organizaziùn che incö l’è cognossüda cuma Uniòn Européa.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: El Drukgyal Dzong l’è na fortèza in ruina e ün monastee budìst sun de la pàrt superiùr del distrètt de Paro (in tel vilàgg de Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: El se dìs che in tel 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel l’era facc sü la fortèza per cumemurà la sò vitória cuntra i fòrz tibetàn e mùngui.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: In tel 1951, a causa de n’incéndi i eren rimàst dumò en quai reliqui del Drukgyal Dzongì, cuma l’imagìn de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Dopu l’incéndi, la fortèza l’è stada preservàda e prutèta, e la rèsta vüna di atraziùn püssé sensàziunai del Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Lung el XVIII secùl la Cambògia la s’era truvada schisciàda tra dù visìn potént, la Thailàndia e al Vietnàm.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: In tel XVIII secùl i Thai i eren invadüü la Cambògia parécc vòlt e in tel 1772 i eren dastrüt Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: In di ültèm ann del XVIII secùl, anca el Vietnàm l’era invadüü la Cambogia.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: El desdòtt percént di venezuelàn ienn senza laorà, e la grànd pàrt de chi g’ha laorà i laurén in de l’ecunumìa infurmàl.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dü tèrz di venezuelàn chi laurén i fàn pàrt del setùr di servìzi, quasi ün quàrt ne l’indüstria e ün quìnt ne l’agricultüra.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Ün’indüstria impurtànt per i venezuelàn l’è el petròli del qual el paés l’è esportaduu net, anca se dumò el vün percént laùra dent a l’indüstria del petròli.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Al princìpi de l’indipendenza de la naziùn, l’esperiénza di giardin botanìc de Singapur l’era contribüii a trasfurmaa l’isùla in üna cità giardin trupicàl.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: In tel 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, n’ibrìd de orchidéa, l’era sta scernii cuma fiuur naziunàl de la naziùn.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Ogni ann, inturn a otobar, quasi 1,5 miliùn de erbìvui i viagén per i piögg dai culìn del nòrd vérs i pianür del süd e i straversàn el fiüm Mara.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: E dopu i piögg, inturn avril, i turnén indréé al nòrd travérsi l’ovést, e i straversàn amò el fiüm Mara.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: La regiùn del Serengeti la gh'ha denter el Parc Naziunàl del Serengeti, l’Area de Conservaziùn del Ngorongoro, la Resèrva de Càscia Maswa in Tanzania e la Resèrva Naziunàl de Maasai Mara in Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Imparà a creà media interatìf al necessìta cumpeténz cunvenziunai e tradiziunai, e anca strüment padrunegiaa in di clàss interatìf (storyboarding, editing audio e video, storytelling, ecet.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: La progetaziùn interatìva la necessìta de revalütà i tö suposiziùn sü la produziùn di media e imparà a pensà in üna manéra che l’è mia lineàr.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: La progetaziùn interatìva la necessita che i cumpunent den prugèt i sienn culegaa tra lùr, ma anca che i abien séns cuma entità separada.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: El cùntra di obietìf zoom l’è che la cumplesità fucàl e al numér di elemént del'obietìf necessari per otegnì üna gàma de lunghèzz fucai l’è ben püssé grand di obietìf a fucàl fìssa.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Chesto l’è dré a diventà menu prublematec perché i produtür de obietìf i rivén a standard püssé elevaa in de la produziùn de obietìf.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Chesto l’ha permetuu ai obietìf zoom de prodürär imagìn de qualità paragunabil a quela otegnìda di obietìf cun la lunghèzza fucàl fìssa.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: N’olter cùntra di obietìf zoom l’è che l’avertüra màsima (velocità) di obietìf da solét l’è püssé lénta.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Per 'sta reson i obietìf zoom ecunomich ienn dificìl de duperà in cundiziùn de scarza lüs senza el flash.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Vün dei problemi qi en g’ha quand se cunvert un film in tel furmat DVD, l’è la sorascansiun.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Quasi tuti i television ien fà per piasè a tücc.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Per 'sta reson, qel qe te vedèt in television el g’ha i bordi tajà de sura, de suta e de part.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: In sta maniera el imajin l’è su tut al schèrmo. La se ciàma sorascansiun.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: L’è na sfortuna qe quand te fà en DVD, l’è prubabil qe i bordi ienn tajà e se ‘l video al g’hà la version scrivuda trop visina al fond, te pödet mia vedei per intreg.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: El tradizional castel medieval ha per tant temp enspirad ‘l emaginazion e ‘l fa vegner in ment i duéi a caàl, i banchets e i storje de Re Artù.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Enfina a vesser intra i ruine veje de centiner de agn a ‘l é belfàr figurar-s de senter a i romor e i odor de bataje de tants agn indré, de poder olzar i còsp dei cavai in sœi resoi e ‘l odor de la pagura qe la ven sœ dei prexon.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ma la nosta idea de qel temp lì coreta? Perqè i castei a i henn staits faits sœ? Coma se fava a far-i sœ e coma a i eren progetats?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Tipic de quel témp, el Castèl de Kirby Muxloe l’è püssé üna cà fortificada che un veri e propi castèl.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: I sò grànd finèster vetraa e i mür sutìl i saresén mia riessii a resìstar ün atàch longh per tàt tép.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Inturno al 1480, quand la sò costruziùn l’era incuminciada da Lord Hasting, el paès l’era assée pasìfic e la difésa l’era necessarìa dumò cuntra picui bandi di predùn chi giravén.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: L'equilibèr del pudè l’era ün sistéma in tel quàl i naziùn européi i cercavén de mantegnì la suvranità naziunàl sü tücc i staa européi.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: El concét l’era che tücc i naziùn européi i gheren de cercà de impedì che üna naziùn la vegnìva poténta, e donca i guvèrn naziunài despéss i cambiavén i lür aleaa per pudè mantegnì l’equilibèr.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: La Guèra de Sucessiùn Spagnöla l’è stada la prìma guèra che la gaveva cuma questiùn centràl l'equilibèr del pudè.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Chèstu l’era segnaa ün cambiamént impurtànt, perchè i puténzi européi gavevan pü el pretèst de vès in guèr de religiùn. Pertànt, la Guèra di trent’ann l’era stada l’ültima guèra a vès cunsiderada guèra de religiùn.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: El templi de Artemide e Efeso l’era sta desfà el 21 lüi in tel 356 a.C. de ün incendi duluus fàcc de Erostrato.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Segònd la storìa, la sò mutivaziòn l’era vès famùs a tücc i cùst. I efesìn, indignaa, ieren anunciàà che el nòmm Erostrato el serà mai staa regurdaa.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: El storìc gréch Strabo l’era poi segnà el nòmm, che l’è quel che cognùssum incö. El templì l’era staa desfà la stèssa sira che l’era nassü Alessander el Grànd.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alessander, cuma rè, el s’era ofrì de pagà per fà sü el templi a nöf, ma la sò uférta l’era stada respìnta. In seguìt, dopu che Alessander l’era mòrt, el templi l’era staa fàcc sü a nöf in tel 323 a.C.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Cuntròla che i tò màn ienn in paas el püssè pusibìl quand te tuchét giüstamént i nòt - pruva anca a fa mia tròp müimènt estràni cunt i tò diit.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: In sta manèra, te se stracarà el mèn posibìl. Regordéss che bisugna mia tucà i tàst cun parécc fòrza per svulzà il volüm cuma col piano.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Per svulzà il volüm cun la fisarmonica te ghe de duperà el mantés con püssè presiùn o velocità.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: El misticism l’è la ricerca de la comuniùn, identità o cunsapevolèza cusciént de üna verità ültima, divinità, verità spiritual o Dio.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Chi el créd el cerca ün’esperiénza dirèta, ün’intuiziùn o cumprensiùn de üna verità divìna/üna o püssé divinità.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: I seguàci i seguisén di specifeg manér de vìf o prateg che ienn miraa a cultivà quei esperienzi.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: El misticism al se diferenzia di olter fòrm de credo e veneraziùn religiùsa per la sò enfàsi sü l’esperiénza persunàl diréta de ün ünic staa de cusciénza, suratöt quei de caratér pacifich, prufùnd, giuiüs e parfin estatìc.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: El Sikism l’è üna religiùn del sub-continént indiàn. L’era nassuu ne la regiùn del Punjab in tel XV secùl da üna divisiùn de sétt dènt la tradiziùn indù.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: I Sik cunsideràn la lür féd üna religiùn separada da l’induism anca se i ricugnussén che l’ha gha radìs e tradiziùn indù.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: I Sik ciamén la lür religiùn Gurmat che in Punjabi vör dì “via del gùru”. El gùru l’è un aspétt fundamentàl di religiùn indian ma in tel Sikism l’ha ciapaa ün’impurtànza che la sta a la bàs del crèdo Sik.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: La religiùn l’era stada fundada in tel XV secùl da Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Ieren seguitaa in sucessiùn olter nöf guru.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Tutavia, in tel giügn 1956, i prumèss de Krushchev ieren staa metü a la pröva quand in Polònia, ‘ndua i lauraduu ieren drè a prutestà cuntra la mancanza de mangià e i tai a la pàga, i rivòlt ieren deventaa prutèst generai cuntra el comunìsm.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Siben a la fin Krushchev l’era inviaa car armaa per ristabilì l’orden, l’era ceduu a üna quai richiesta economega e acetaa de numinà el popular Wladyslaw Gomulka cuma nöf prim ministér.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: La civiltà de la vàl de l’Indo l’era üna civiltà de l’Età del bronz in del subcontinent indiàn nòrd-ocidèntal chel cumprendìva la grànd pàrt del Pakistan d’incö e üna quai regiùn in de l’India nòrd-ocidèntal e de l’Afghanistan nòrd-orientàl.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: La civiltà la se svilupàva in di basin del fiüm Indo del qual ciàpa el nomm.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Anca se an quai studius i pénsa che, si come la civiltà la ghera anca in di basin del fiüm Sarasvati che adès l’è in sèca, la doeréss vès giüstament ciamàda civiltà de l’Indo-Sarasvati. Inveci quaivun la ciàma civiltà de Harappa, che l’è el prìm sit a vès staa scavaa in di ann ‘20 del 1900.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: La natüra militaristìca de l’Imperi Roman l’era stada ütil per el svilìp di prugrèss de la medesìna.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: I dutùr ieren cumincià a vès reclutaa da l’imperador Augusto e ieren anca formà el prìm Còrp medic roman che l’era de vés doprà dopu i batài.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: I chirurg i cugnussiven vari sedatìf di quai la murfìna che la vegnìva di estràtt dei suménz di papavér e la scopolamìna che la vegnìva del Giusquiam neghér.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Ieren diventaa espert de amputaziùn per salvaa i paziencc de la cancrèna, e anche de làcc emustatég e pìnzi arteriùs per arginà el flüss sanguineo.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: In tel passà de vari secùi, l’Imperi Roman l’era purtaa a grànd conquisti in tel càmp de la medisìna e l’era mèss inséma grànd part de la conossénsa che ghem al dì d’incö.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland origami l’è origami cul límit che en gha de fà üna piéga a la vòlta, piég püssé cumplèss cuma i piég a l’invèrsi ienn mia cetaa, e tücc i piég i ghan pusiziùn semplix.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: L’era sta svilupaa da John Smith in di ann ‘70 del 1900 per iutà i piegaduu senza esperiénza o cun capacità de müimènt limitàda.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: I fiolitt svilupèn sin da pütost giuvèn üna cunsapevolèza de la razza e di stereotip razziàl, chi influenzén i lùr cumpurtamént.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Par esempi, i fiolitt chi se identifichén cun la minurità razziàl che l’è stereotipàda cuma quela che la và mia bén a scöla, quand i han cognossuu el sterotìp legaa a la lùr razza i tendén ad andà mia bén a scöla.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: El MySpace l’è el tèrz sit el püssèè famùs in tei Statt Ünii e ‘l g’ha registràà 54 migliun de gént.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: ‘Sti sit enn parècc attenziun, anca per l’educaziun.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: I sit ienn na bùna roba e i te lasèn urganizzàr üna pagina cun blog, videu, futugrafii e quant olter.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Te pödet vardà ‘sta pagìna cun dumò vün indiriz del web, donca l’è fàcil de regurdass anca per i stüdent qe g’han mia dimesticheza cun la tastiera o ‘sti nóm.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Te ‘l pödet cambià si te voret lèncc e anca cambià el culuur cuma te vöret.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.
