text: El destürbi da deficit d’atenziùn l’è “üna sindrom neurologìca cunt üna classega triàd de sintum distintìf chi inclüdén impülsuvità, destraibilità, iperatività e energìa in ecéss”.
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: L’è mia ün handicap de aprendimént, l’è ün destùrb de aprendimént; el “culpiss da 3 a 5 percént di tücc i fiolitt, fursi fin a 2 miliùn de fiolitt americàn”.
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: I fiolitt cunt DDA i ghan dificultà a cuncentràss sü ròp cuma el càrich scölastèg, ma i pòden cuncentràss sü ròp che i ghe piàss fà cuma giugà, vardà i lùr cartun animaa preferii o scrìf fràs senza puntegiatüra.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Sti fiolitt i tendén a casciàss in di guai, perchè i “partecipén in cumpurtamént periculùs, i tàchen a lìt, i sfiden l’autorità” al fin de stimulà el lùr scervèl, si cuma el lùr scervèl pò mia vèss stimulà dai metud nurmai.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: El DDA influìss sui relaziùn cun i olter cumpàgn perchè i olter fiolitt i pòden mia capì el motìf di lùr aziùn, cuma i scrivén i paròll e che el lùr livèl de madüridà l’è mia istèss.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Si come l’abilità de otegnì conossénsa e de imparà l’era cambiada inscì tànt, cuma menziunaa de sùra, l’era cambiaa anca la velocità de bas cunt la qual la se otégn la conossénsa.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: L’aprocc per otegnì infurmaziùn l’era divèrs. La pressiùn la stava pü in tel ricòrd individuàl, ma l’abilità de regurdàss ün testo l’era vegnüda püssé impurtànt.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: In sustanza, el Renassiment l’ha purtaa ün cambiamént impurtànt in te l’aprocc a l’imparà e a là difisiùn de la conossénsa.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: A diferénza di olter primaa, i ominìdi i dopravén pü i lùr màn per la locumuziùn o purtà pés o rampegàss sun ti albér.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: La màn e ‘l pè del scimpanzé ienn sìmil de taia e lunghèza, e ìndican che i màn ieren doprà per sustagnì el pés intant che i caminavén süi nòcch.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: La màn di umàn l’è püssé cùrta di pè, cun falàngi püssé drìzz.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Retrovament di òss di màn de dù o tri miliùn de ann fa i rivélen chèst cambiamènt in te la specializaziùn de la màn da locumuziùn a manipulaziùn.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Üna quai persùna la pénsa che sperimentà parécc sùgn indùtt artificialmènt pütòst despèss el pò vès propi stancànt.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: La resùn püssé grànda de sto fenomen l’è el risultaa di sùgn lüsid chi slarghén la durada del témp tra i staa REM.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Cunt menu REM per nòcc, el staa in tel qual se dòrma debòn e ‘l tò còrp recüpera el diventa menu frequént tànt da vès ün problema.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Chestu qui el te stanca cuma sveglias ogni vint o trenta minut e vardà la televisiùn.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: L’efet che te fa el cambia a segunda di volt che il to scervel el pröva a sugnà de nòcc.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Del’inizi, i rop naven mia ben par i italian in nort Africa. Dent una setimana dala dichiaraziun de guera del’Italia, el 10 giugn 1940 el XI Hussari de l’Inghiltera ha ciapait Fort Capuzzo in Libia.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Dent a n’imbuscada a l’est de Bardia, i ingles avevan ciapait el general Lastucci, capo ingegner de la decima armada italiana.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: El 28 giugn, el marescial Italo Balbo qe l’era governatur general de la Libia e ‘l par anca erede del Mussolini, l’è stait mazzait da föch amìs in temp che nava giò a Tobruk.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: El spòrt mudèrn de la schèrma l’è giügaa a parécc livei, da stüdent universitari a cumpetiziùn prufessiunai e olimpich.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: El spòrt l’è giügaa principalment in ün formaa de duel, ün schermiduu cuntra l’olter.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: El gòlf l’è ün giög indùa i giügaduu i dopéren di màzz per culpì i bucìn e fali andà dènt i büs.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Üna partìda nurmàl l’è fàda de desdòtt büs, e i giügaduu de solìt i cumincién dal prìm büs del càmp e i finìssen cun tel desdotésim.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: I giügaduu chi i cumpleten el càmp cunt el minùr numèr de cùlp o de müimènt de la màzza, i vénc.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: El giög el se giüga sun de l’erba, e l’erba inturna al büs l’è taiada curta e la se ciama green.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: L’è pussibil che la forma püssé comün de türism l’è quela che la major part de la gent la culega al viagià: el türism de ricreaziùn.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Chèstu l’è quand la gent la va in den pòst che l’è parécc divers dal solet tram tram de tücc i ì per pusà e divertiss.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Spiagi, parchi de divertiment e campegi spess ien i pòst püssé comün indùa i van i türist ricreaziunai.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Si l’obietif de üna visita a ün sìt particulàr l’è de cugnùss la sò storia e coltüra, alura sto tip de türism l’è cognussuu cuma türism coltüral.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: I türist i pòden visità i sìt püssé impurtànt de üna naziun particulàr o i pòden decidì de concentràs domà en de n’area.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Quand i colòni ieren veduu sto müimènt, i eren anca ciamaa i rinfòrzi.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: I trùpp chi i rafurzavén i pusiziùn denàns i ghevan el 1° e il 3° regiment del New Hampshire cunt 200 omén, cumandaa dai colunèl John Stark e James Reed (in seguìt diventaa tüti i dò generai).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: I omén di Stark i eren ciapà pusizìùn lung la recinziùn a l’estremità nòrt de la postaziùn di colòni.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Quand la bàsa maréa l’era dervìì un varch lung el Mystic River in tel nòrt-èst de la penìsula, i eren slungaa in prèsa la recinziùn a nòrt cunt un mür cürt de pédra biànca che el terminàva a la rìva de üna spiàgia picùla.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley o Stark ieren mettü un pàl de 100 pè (30 m) inanz a la recinziùn e ieren cumandaa de mia sparà fin a quand i soldaa l’avesen mia süperaa.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: El piàn di americàn l’era de lancià di atàch curdinaa di tri divèrsi direziùn.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: El generàl John Cadwalder l’era lancià un atàch diversìf cuntra l’armada britànèga a Bordentwon, per blucà i rinfòrzi.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: El generàl James Ewing l’era purtaa 700 suldaa travers el fiüm a Trenton Ferry, l’era ciapaa el pùnt sü l’Assunpink Creek e l’era empedì de scapà ai trùpp nemich.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: La püssé grànda fòrza d’assalt de 2400 omén l’era traversaa el fiüm a nöf miglia a nòrt de Trenton, e dopu la s’era dividuda in dò grupp, vün cumandaa de Greene e vün de Sullivan, per lancià un atàch prima de la levada del suu.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Cul cambiamént de la corsa de un quart de mia a mèza mia, la velocità l’è pü inscì impurtanta e la resistenza la diventa la necessitaa püssè grànda.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Naturalment, un mèzzfundista de prima clàss, un òmm che el pò bàtt i dù minüt, al ghà de vèch üna bùna velocità, ma la resistenza ghà de vèss cultivada a tücc i cùst.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: ‘Na quai cursa in campàgna d’invern cumbinada a esercizi in palèstra per la pàrt superiùr del còrp l’è la preparaziùn meiùr per la stagiùn di curs.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Üna giüsta alimentaziùn deperlee la pò mia purtà a prestaziùn d’élite, ma la pò influì prufundament sul benesar generàl di atléti.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Mantegnì un san equilìbri di energii, vèch abitudin d’idrataziun eficiént, e capì i vari aspètt di pratég de integraziùn, i iüta i atléti a migliurà i propi prestaziùn e a fà créss el lùr piasé vers el spòrt.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: La cùrsa a média distànza l’è un spòrt pütòst ecunomich; tutavia, ghè di idei sbaiaa süi pòcch pèzz de equipagiamént che i ocorén per partecipà.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: I ròbi pòden vès cumpraa al bisùgn, ma la grànd part la ghavarà pòcch o nissün efèt sü la prestaziùn.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: I atléti pudaressen sentì che i preferissen üna ròba a l’oltra anca quand la furniss mia de resultaa reài.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: L’atum el pò vèss cunsideraa vun di elemènt costitutif fundamentai de tüta la matéria.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: L’è ün’entitàa parécc cumplèsa che la cunsìst, segùnd el mudel semplificaa de Bohr, de un nücli centràl cun di eletrùn che i ghe orbitén inturno, in üna quai manéra simìl ai pianéti che orbitén inturno al suu - varda la Figüra 1.1.
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: El nücli el cunsist de dù partizèli: neutrùn e prutùn.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: I prutùn i ghan üna caréga elètrega pusitiva, inveci i neutrùn i ghan mia de caréga. I eletrùn i ghan üna caréga elètrega negatìva.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Per cuntrulà la vitima, te ghe prima de ispeziunà la scéna per garantì la tò sicüreza.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Te ghe de fà càs a la pusiziùn de la vitima e a un quai campanèl d’alarma quand te và visìn.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Si te se fett maa a cercà de iüttà, te pòdet dumò pegiurà la situaziùn.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: El stüdi l’ha scuprìt che la depressiùn, la pagüra e ‘l catastrufizzà i fàn da intermediàri tra duluu e disabilità a chi el patìss de lumbalgìa.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Dumò i efét del catastrufizzà, mia de la depressiùn e de la pagüra, i eren cundiziunaa da sessiùn regulari setimanai de atività fisica strütürada.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Chi el fasìva atività regulàr el necesitàva de püssé iütt in tèrmen de perceziùn negatìva del duluu e ‘l distingueva i diferénzi tra duluu crònic e sensaziùn de fastìdi chi i vegnén da ün’atività fisica nurmàl.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: La vìsta, o el podè vedè, la dipent dai orghén sensuriai del sistèma visìv o öcc.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Ghà parécc costruziùn divèrsi di öcc, chi varién de cumplesità a segùnda di necessitaa de l’organism.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: I divèrsi costruziùn i ghan capacità divèrsi, ienn sensibal a divèrsi longhèzz d’unda e i ghan divèrsi gràd de acutèza, e i necesiten anca de ün’elaburaziùn divèrsa per dà un sèns a l’input e de numèr divèrsi per laurà bén.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Üna populaziùn l’è l’inséma di urganìsm de üna spéce particulàr dent a üna specìfega area geugrafica.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Quand tücc i esemplar de üna populaziùn ienn uguài per chèl che riguàrda un tràt fenutipic particulàr ienn cognossuu cuma monomorfìc.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Quànd i esemplar i mustrén parécc variànti de un particulàr tràt ienn polimorfic.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: I colòni di formig legiunàri i caminén e i fà la nìada in fàs diferént.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: In te la fàs nomàd, i formig i caminén de nòcc e se fèrmen a durmì in del dì.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: La colònia la cumincia üna fàs nomàd quand el mangià dispunibìl l’è diminuii. In de sta fàs, la colònia la fa nìadi tempuranei chi végn cambià tücc i dì.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Ognün di sti caminà o füri nomàd el düra 17 dì circa.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Còsa l’è üna cèlula? La paròla celùla la végn da la paròla latìna “cella” che la vör dì “stanzìn”, e l’è stada doperàda per la prìma vòlta da un microscupist che l’era dree a oservà la strütüra del sughér.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: La cèlula l’è la unitaa de bas de tücc i esàr vivént, e tücc i organìsm ienn fà de üna o püssé cèluli.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: I cèluli ienn inscì esenziai e fundamentai per el studi de la vìda, che de fàtt, ienn despèss ciamà “i elemènt costitutif de la vìda”.
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: El sistèma nervùs al mantegniss l’omeostàsi cunt l’invìo de impùlsi nervùsi travèrs el còrp per mantegnì el fluss de sang custànt e mia disturbaa.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Chèsti impùlsi nervùsi i pòden vès inviaa inscì a manèta travérs el còrp, che el iuttà a mantegnì el còrp al sigür de ogni pusibìl minàcia.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: I tornado i culpìssen ün’area picùla rispèt a oltri tempèst viulenti, ma i pòden desfà tüt quel che ghè sü la lùr via.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: I tornado i strépan albér, i scarpén via ass di edifìzi e slanzén i machìn in del ciél. El püssé viulént dò per cént di tornado i düren püssé de tri ur.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Sti tempèst spaventùs i ghan vént fin a 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: I umàn i fan sü e i dopéren lent per engrandì da miaia e miaia de ann.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Tutavia, i prìm vér telescòpi ieren sta fà sü in Euròpa a la fin tel 16esim secùl.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Sti telescòpi duperàven üna combinaziùn de dò lent per fà cumparì i ogèt luntàn püssé visìn e püssé grànd.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Engurdìscia e vés egoìsti i seran semper cun nün e l’è la natüra de la coperaziùn che quand la grànd pàrt la trà vàntagg ghe serà semper de guadagnà püssè dent un témp cort se an se cumpòrta in manèra egoìsta
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Se spéra che la grànd pàrt di gént i capiràn che la lùr meiur opziùn dent un témp lòng l’è de laurà insema ai oltér.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Parècc persùnn i sugnén el dì in tel qual i umàni i pòderan viagià vèrs ün’oltra stèla o esplurà olter mùnd, üna quai persùna la se dumànda cusa ghè là föra e quaivùn el créed che i aliéni o oltri fùrmi de vida i pudarissen vif su un olter planeta.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Ma, anca se chést duaréss mai sucéét l’è probabìl che ‘l sucederà mia per parécc témp. I stèl ienn inscì spantegaa che en gha triliùn de miia tra stèl chi ienn “visìn”.
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Fòrsi un dì, i tò pronevòd i saràn süra un mùnd aliéno e i se interugaran di lùr antìch antenaa.
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: I animài ienn fà de parécc cèluli. I mangén ròpp e i digerissén dadént. La grànd pàrt di animài la pò möves.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Dumò i animài i ghan el scervèl (anca se mia tücc i animài; i medùsi par esempi, ghan mia de scervèl).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: I animài i se trùven sü tüta la tèra. I scàven in del terén, i nodén in di uceani e i vùlen in di cièl.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Üna celùla l’è l’ünità strütüral e funziunàl püssé picùla de un organìsim (esàr) vivènt.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Celùla la végn da la paròla latìna cella che la vör dì stanzìn.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Si te vardét i esàr vivént sùta un microscopi, te vedarà che ienn fà de picùi quadraa o bàl.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, un biològ inglés, cunt un microscopi l’era veduu picùi quadraa dént al sughér.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: I someiavén a stanzìn. L’era stada la prìma persùna a uservà i cèluli mòrti
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: I elemént e i cumpòst i pòden spustass de un stat a l’olter e mia cambià.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: El nitrogén cuma gas al gha ancamò i stèss proprietà del nitrogén liquìd. El stàt liquìd l’è püssé spèss ma i mulécoli ienn amò istess.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: L’aqua l’è un olter esempi. El cumpòst de l’aqua l’è fa de dù atòm de idrogén e ün atòm de ussigen.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Si gas, liquìd o solèd, el ghà l’istessa strütüra muleculàr.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Anca se el sò stat fisech el podarés cambià, el sò stat chimig el rèsta istess.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: El témp l’è vargòt che l’è tütt inturn a nùn, e l’influénza chel che fèmm, ma l’è dificìl de capì.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: El témp l’è sta stüdiaa per miaia de ann da studiùs religiùs, filosòfeg e scientìfeg.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Nùn vivùm el témp cuma üna seri de fàtt chi passén dal futür tramìt el presént e el passaa.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: El témp l’è anca cuma nùn an cunfrùnta la dürada (lunghéza) di fàtt.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Te pòdet segnà el passà del témp cunt l’oservaziùn de la ripetiziùn de fàtt ciclìc. Un fàtt ciclìc l’è vargòt che el sucéet semper in manéra regulàr.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Incö i compüter ienn doperà per modificà imagìn e video.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Süi compüter pòden vès fà animaziùn sufisticaa, e chést tìp de animaziùn l’è semper püssé doperàà in televisiùn e in di fìlm.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: La müsega l’è despess registràda cunt compüter sufisticaa che i processén e i mes’cen inséma i sòni.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Per parécc témp, lung el desnofesim e vintesim secùl, al se credìva che i prìm abitànt de la Növa Zelànda ieren el popùl Maori, che el casciàva graand üsei ciamaa moas.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: La teòria l’ha pö stabilì l’idea che el popùl Maori el s’era spustaa da la Polinésia cunt üna Grànd Flòta e l’era ciapaa di Moriori la Növa Zelànda, e fundaa üna società agricùla.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Tutavia, növi prövi i sugerissén che i Moriori ieren un grùp de Maori cuntinentai chi si eren spustaa de la Növa Zelànda ai Isùli Chatham, e svilupaa la lùr propia coltùra distintìva e de paas.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Ghèra anca ün’oltra tribuu sun di Isùli Chatham, chésti ieren i Maori che i se eren spustaa de la Növa Zelànda.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: I se ciamavén Moriori, gheran staa di scònter e a la fin ieren sta spazaa via
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: I persùnn che ienn sta cuinvòlt per parécc desèni i ghan iüta a aprezà i nòs fòrzi e passiùn intànt che en valütava cunt onestà ai dificultà e persin ai falìment.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Intant che i persùnn i cuntàven sü i lùr stòri individuài, familiàr e de pianificaziùn, nùn ghem quistà infurmaziùn preziùsi sül passaa e sü üna quai personalità che l’era influenzàà l’organizaziùn in del bén o in del màl.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Siben la comprensiùn de la pròpia stòria la dà mia per scuntàà la comprensiùn de la coltüra, almen la iüta i gént a capì indùa i se trüven in de la stòria de l’organizaziùn.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Intant che i i valütan i succèss e i ciapén cuscienza di falìment, i persùnn e tüta la gént che la partecìpa i descuvrissén püssé prufundamént i valùr, la missiùn e i fòrzi tirànt de l’organizaziùn.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: In chést cas chì, regurdàss i precedent esèmpi de cumpurtamént imprendituriàl e i sò succèss l’ha iüta i persùnn a vès vèrt a nöf cambiamént e a nöf direziùn per la giésa locàl.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Sti stòri de succèss i han fà decrèss la pagüra del cambiamént, e intel istèss moment i han creaa inclinaziùn pusitìv vérs el cambiamént in tel futür.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Pensà convergent l'è öna tècnega per solf e problémi ca la önes svariade edèe o sectùr per troà öna solussiù.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: La crapa la g’ha de laorà de prèssa, de logica e de precisiùn, la g’ha de identificà qel qe ‘l suceda e dopràr la sò tecnega e truvär i infurmazion.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: La roba la pussè impurtant de ‘sto pensèè l’è qe el g’ha dumò vüna rispòsta giüsta. Te pödet pensà dumò düü ropp, giüst o mia giüst.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: ‘Sto pensèè l’è aprööf de na quaj sciènsa o manéra de fà.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Qi ‘l g’ha ‘sto pensèè ‘l g’ha nà logica, e l’è bun de regurdass e andà incontro a un problema e laorà sun di liber de sciènsa.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: I umàn ienn propi la spéce püssé capàs de léngg la mént di òlter.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: El vör dì che an sé bùn de prevedar cunt succèss quel che i umàn i sènten, i vören, i créden, i sànn e i bràman.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Tra chésti capacità, capì l'intenzion di òlter l’è fundamentàl. El permèt de vegnìghen fö de pusibìl ambiguità di aziùn fisegh.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Par esempi, si te vedaress quaivun che el sfràca el finestrèn de üna machìna, l’è pusìbil che te pensaréss che l’era dree a pruvà a robà la machìna de un estràni.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: El doaréss vés giudicaa diversamènt si l’era perduu i sò ciàv de la machìna e l’era la sò machìna quela indua el pruvava a andà dént.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: La risunanza magnetica l’è basada sül fenomén ciamaa risunanza magnetica nülclear (RMN), che l’era sta scuprìt in di ann ‘30 del 1900 da Felix Bloch (che el laurava a la Stanford University) e Edward Purcell (de la Harvard University).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: In chésta risunanza, el càmp magnetic e i ùndi ràdio i fàn sì che i atùm i mandén minuscùi segnai ràdio.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: In de l’ann 1970, Raymond Damadian, dutuu e ricercadùr, l’ha scuprìt la bàs per doperà la risunanza magnetica cuma strüment per l’anàlisi médega.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Quatér ann dopu l’era sta concéss un brevet, che l’era el prìm brevet al mùnd emetü in del càmp de la risunanza magnetica.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: In tel 1977, el dutuu Damadian l’era cumpletaa la costruziùn del prìm scaner de RM per còrp intrèch, che l’era ciamaa “Indumabìl”.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: La comunicaziùn asìncrona la cunséia témp per pensà e per rispònd ai òlter.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: La permèt ai stüdént de pudè laurà cunt el propi ritmo e cuntrulà el ritmo di infurmaziùn de la formaziùn.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ghè anca menu vincùl de oràri cunt la possibiltà de véch oràri lauratìf flesìbil. (Bremer, 1998)
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: El doperà Internet e ‘l World Wide Web el permèt ai stüdént de vèch semper acèss a l’infurmaziùn.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: I stüdént i pòden anca fà dumàndi ai insegnant a ogni ùra del dì e i se spécien rispòst assé svelt, pütòst che specià el prossim inconter fàcia a fàcia.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: L’apròch post-mudern a l’aprendimént el ofrìs la libertà di assolùti. Ghè mia üna manéra bùna de imparà.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: De fatt, ghè mia üna ròba bùna de imparà. L’aprendimént l’è in de l’esperienza tra ‘l stüdént e la conossénsa presentàda.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: La nòsa esperienza d'incö con tücc i prugràm televisìv fundaa sü l’aprendimént chi i presentén infurmaziùn e fa-deper-ti la demùstra chést pònt.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Parècc de nualtri i se trüva a vardà prugràm televisìv chi i infùrmen del procèss o de l’esperienza a la qual parteciparem mai o dopererem mai quela conossénsa.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Giustarém mai üna machìna, farém sü mai üna funtana in tel nòs cortìl, viagerém mai in Perù a vedè antich ruin, o prugeterém mai la cà del nòs visìn.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Grazie ai culegamént sutamarìn de fìbra òtega vèrs l’Euròpa e al satelitàr a bànda làrga, la Groenlàndia l’è ben culegada cunt el 93% de la populaziùn che l’ha ghà acèss a internèt.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: L’è posìbil che el tò hotel o padrùn de cà (se te stee in üna pensiùn o cà privàda) i ghavràn wifi o un PC culegaa a internèt, e tücc i paés i ghàn un internèt café o un quai pòst cunt wifi püblich.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Incö in tei Stat Ünii te pödet dì “eschimès”, ma il piàss mia a la gent de l’artich qe l’è mia americana, süra tücc se l’è in Canada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: ‘Sta paròla l’è dopràt di natif in Groenlandia ma l’è mei qe i stranier la üsen mia.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: I natif de la Groenlandia tra de luur i se ciamen Inuit in Canada o Kalaalleq (el plural l’è Kalaallit) in Groenlandia.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: La delinquénza e la cativéria vers i fùrest in generàl l’è praticamént mia congnossüda in Groenlandia. Anca in di cità, ghè mia de “brüti aree”.
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: El témp frécc l’è fórsi l’ünic pericùl vér che el ghà de afruntà chi l’è mia preparaa.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Si te visitet la Groenlandia in de la stagiùn frègia (cunsidera che püssé te ve a nòrt, püssé el sarà frécc), l’è fundamentàl purtàss dré vestii assé còlt.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: I giornàd parécc longhi de l’estaa i pòden causà prublemi per durmì a suficiénza e prublemi de salùt ligaa a quel.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: In estaa, stà atènti anca ai zanzàr del nòrd. Anca se i trasmèten mia de malatii, i pòden vès fastidiùs.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Ménter l’econumia di San Francisco l’è culegada al vès ün’atraziùn türistega de livèl mundiàl, la sò economia l’è diversificàda.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: I püssé grànd settòr ocupaziunài ienn i servìzi professiunai, el govern, la finanza, el cumèrci e ‘l türism.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: La sò frequent representaziùn in de la müsega, film, leteratüra e coltüra populàr l’ha contribuii a fà cugnùss la cità e i sò monumént in tütt el mùnd.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco l’ha svilüpàà una grànd infrastrütüra türistega cunt parécc hotel, resturànt e strütür per i cungrèss de prìma qualità.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco l’è anca vun dì meiòr pòst de la naziùn per la cüsina asiatega: kureana, thai, indiana e japonesa.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Andà al Walt Disney World el rapresénta un pelegrinagg impurtànt per parécc famej americàn.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: La visita “tìpica” l’è vulà a l’aeropòrt internaziunàl de Orlando, ciapà un bùs vèrs un hotel Disney sül sìt, passàà circa üna setimana senza mai andà via del sìt Disney e turnà a cà.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: I ghén infinii variaziùn pusìbil, ma chéstu al rèsta quel che la gént cunsidera quand la parla de “andà a Disney World”.
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Parècc bigliétt vendüü online sü sìt de astì cuma eBay o Craiglist ienn bigliètt park-hopper valìd püssé dì chi ienn staa doperà in pàrt.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Anca se l’è üna pràtega parécc comün, l’è pruibìda da Disney: i bigliètt ienn mia trasferìbil.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Per mèt giò la tenda in tel Gran Canyon te g’he bisugna ‘sto permèss.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: I permèss ienn stà limità per protegg el canyon, donca ienn dispunibil del prim del mès, quatro mès prima qe ‘l mès scumanza.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Dal prim de genar te pödet dumandà el permèss per pudè met giò la tò tenda in magg e passa.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Quand i dervèn gli iscriziùn, sit famus cuma il camp Bright Angel visin al Phantom Ranch i se impienìsen al prim dì.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: El numér di permèss per chi mia prenutàt, che prima te rivèt e prima te’l ciapèt, l’è limitàc.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Andà dènt l’Afrìca Meridiunàl cunt la machìna l’è üna manéra meravigliüsa de vedé tüta la beléza de la regiùn e anca rivà ai sìt che ienn mia süi nurmài vìi türistegh.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Chèst pò vès facc cunt üna machìna nurmàla, cunt üna precìsa pianificaziùn, ma l’è parécc cunseiaa un 4x4 e tànti sìt ienn acesìbil dumò cunt un 4x4 a rödi vòlti.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Quand te pianifichét tégn a mént che anca se l’Afrìca Meridiunàl l’è stabìl, mia tücc i paés visìn ienn inscì.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: I richièst e i prèzi del vìsto i varién de naziùn a naziùn e ienn influenzaa del paès de pruveniènza.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Ogni paés el ghà anca lègi üniche che i dumandén quai ogèt de emergénza i ghàn de vès dént la machìna.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls l’è üna cità in de la pàrt ocidentàl del Zimbabwe, passà el confìn da Livingstone, Zambia e visìn al Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: La cità la se trüva propi visìn ai cascaa chi ienn l’atraziùn principàl, ma chésta famüsa destinaziùn türistega la ofrìss a chi ‘l cèrca aventür o ai türist parécc ocasiùn de restà püssè a lungh.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: In de la stagiùn di piöv (de novembar a marz), el volüm de l’aqua el sarà püssè vòlt e i cascaa püssè scénich.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: L’è garantii che te se bagniärà si te travèrset el pùnt o si te camìnet lung i sentee chi i vàn visìn ai cascaa.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: D’òltra pàrt, l’è propi perchè el volüm de l’aqua l’è inscì vòlt che la veduda vèra di cascaa la sarà scondùda da tüta l’aqua!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: La tùmba de Tutankhamon (KV62). Pò vès che la KV62 l’è la püssè famùsa di tùmbi ne la vàl, el sìt de la scuverta in tel 1922 di Howard Carter de la sepoltüra quasi intreega de chèst re giovìn.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: In cunfrunt a la grànd pàrt di olter tùmbi reai, tutavia, la tùmba de Tutankhamon quasi la merìta mia üna visìta perchè l’è püssè picùla e cunt pòchi decuraziùn.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Chi l’è interessaa a vedé la pröva del dàgn fàcc a la mömia quand ieren tentaa de tiràla fö da la sò bara i resteràn màl perché ienn visìbil dumò la cràpa e i spàll.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: I meravigliùs richèzi di tùmbi i ghen pü dént, ma ienn staa tirà fö dal Museo Egìzi al Cairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: I visitaduu cunt pòch témp duaresén passà el lùr témp in oltri pòst.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km a sùd-ovèst de Siem Reap. Chestù templi l’era staa fà sü a la fin del 9 secùl, cunt el régn del re Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: L’atmosféra scüra del templi e la vedùda sül làg de Tonle Sap i renden la salida sü la colina dégn de nòta.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Üna visita al sìt la pò vès cumbinada in manéra pràtega cunt un gìr in bàrca al làgh.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: L’Angkor Pass l’è necessàri per andà dént al templi, donca desméntega mia de purtàt dree el tò pasapòrt quand te see dirètt a Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Gerusalemm l’è la capitàl e la cità püssé grànda de Israele, siben la grànd pàrt di oltèr paés e i Naziùn Ünii i la recugnussen mia cuma capitàl de Israele.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: L’antìga cità sün di colìn de la Giudea la ghà üna stòria interessànta che la düra miaia de ann.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: La cità l’è sàcra per trii religiùn monoteìste: ebraism, cristianésim e Islàm, e la sarviss cuma center spirituàl, religiùs e coltüral.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: A caùsa del valùr religiùs de la cità, e particularment per i parécc sìt in de l’area de la cità véegia, Gerusalemm l’è vüna di majùr destinaziùn türisteg de Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Gerusalemm la ghà parécc sìt coltürai, archeologich e istorich, inséma a centri cumerciai, cafè e resturànt trafegaa e animaa.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: L’Ecuador necessita che i citadìn cubàni i riceven üna lèttra de invìto prima de vegnì denter l’Ecuador tramìt aeropòrt internaziunai e pónt d’entrada de fruntiera.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Chèsta lèttra la ghà de vès ofizialiada dal Ministèr di Afari Ester de l’Ecuador, e vèch specifég carateristeg.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Chèsti carateristeg ienn prugetaa per furnì un flüss migratòri organizaa tra i dò paés.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: I citadìn cubàni chi i ghàn üna green card di Staa Üni i doaresen visità un Consulaa de l’Ecuador per otegnì ün’esenziùn à chésta regùla.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: El tò passaport al ghà de vès valìd per almen 6 mès oltra i daat del tò viàgg. L’è necessari un bigliètt d’andada e ritòrno per pruaà la lunghèza del tò sogiorn.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: I tour ienn püssé economèg per i grüp püssé grànd, donca si te se depertii o cunt dumò un amis, pruua a incuntrà oltra gént e fà sü un grüp da quater a sés per üna tarìfa mejùra a persùna.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Tutavia, chéstu el doares propi mia vès el tò prublema, perché despèss i türist ienn tirà de scià e de là per impienì i machìn.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: In realtaa, el pàr püssé üna manéra de fà creet ai persùnn che i ghan de pagà püssé.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: A l’estremità nòrd de Machu Picchu la se svòlza üna muntàgna érta, despèss el sfùnd de parécc fotografii di ruìn.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: El pàr un pö spaventùs da sùta, e la salìda l’è rìpida e dificìl, ma la gràn pàrt di persùnn assé in saguma i duaresen vès bun de fàghela in 45 minüt circa.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Scalin de pédra ienn piazzà lung la gràn pàrt del sentee, e in di tràtt püssé rìpid i càf d’azàl i furnissen un curimàn de supòrt.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Cun chésta premèsa, te pò specià de vès senza fià, e fa a mént di pàrt püssé rìpid, specialment quand ienn bagnaa, perchè i pòden diventà periculùs in prèsa.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Ghè un picùl anfràtt visìn a la scìma che te ghé de traversà, l’è pütòst bàss e assè strénch.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: L’è mei vardà i sìt e i animài selvateg di Galapagos cunt üna barca, cuma l’era fa Charles Darwin in tel 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Püssé de 60 nàf da croséra i solchén l’aqua di Galapagos, cunt dimensiùn da 8 a 100 passegér.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: La gràn pàrt de la gént la prenùta cunt un bell antìcip (si coma de solìt i bàrch ienn pién in de la vòlta stagiùn).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Sicüress che l’agènt cun tel qual te prenutaa l’è un specialìsta di Galapagos e ‘l ghà üna bùna conossénsa de üna gràn varietà di barchi.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Chèstu te sicürerà che i tò interèss e/o lìmit i saran mettü d’acordi cunt la nàf püssé giüsta.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Prima che i spagnöö i rivassén in tel XVI secùl, el Cile setentriunàl l’era sùta domìni di Inca intant che i indigén Araucani (Mapuche) i abitàven in del Cile central e meridiunal.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: I Mapuche ieren anca vun di ültim grüp indigén american indipendént, che i eren mia staa del tüt tirà dent al domìni de léngua spagnöla fin dopu l’indipendenza de ‘l Cile.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Siben el Cile l’era deciaraa indipendenza in tel 1810 (tra i guèri napoleonich chi ieren lassà la Spagna senza un govern centràl operatìf per dò ann), la vitòria decisìva süi spagnöö l’era mia rivàda fin al 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: La Republéga duminicana (in spagnö República Dominicana) la se truva in di Caraibi, sula metà a est de l’isùla ciamàda Hispaniola qe per metà l’è anca de Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: St’isùla l’ha g’ha spiàgg de sabbia e anca muunt, e propri lì gh’è Sant Doming, la pussé veja di cità européé in di Americhi.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: I Tainos e i Caribes campàven dent st’isùla. I Caribes i parlaven üna léngua ciamada Arawakan e ieren rivà pressapoch in tel 10.000 prima de Crist.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: La gent de Tainos l’era stada dimezzàda dent ün pàra d’ann dopu qi eren rivà i spagnö del Euròpa a cunquistà.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Frà Bartolomé de las Casas l’ha scrivuu in tel sò Tratado de las Indias qe i spagnö ienn cupàà sui 100.000 Taínos del 1492 al 1498.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Chèstu pòst l’era sta fà sü cuma atrio per un cunvent del 17esim secùl, del qual el Templi di San Diego l’è l’ünic edifizi restaa.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Adèss el funziùna cuma piàza centràl, e ghè semper parécc ròpp de fà, dì e nòcc.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Ghè un sac de resturànt inturn al giardìn, e dopomesdì e de sìra ghèn despess cuncert gratìs dal gloriét centràl.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (el vìcol del baso). Dù balcùn separaa dumò da 69 centimeter i òspiten üna legénda d’amùr.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Per un quai centèsim un quai fiolitt te cunterà la stòria.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: L’isùla de Bowen l’è üna gità populàr de ‘n dì o ün’escursiùn per el weekend che la ofrìss kayak, caminàdi, negòzi, resturànt, e oltèr.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Chèsta comünità genüina la se truua a Howe Sound apéna föra Vancouver, e l’è facilmént acessìbil cunt taxi d’aqua de linea chi partén de Granville Island in del center de Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Per quei che ghè piàss i atività a l'avert, un trekking in tel coridor del Sea to Sky l’è fundamentàl.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1.5 ùr de machìna da Vancouver) l’è càra ma ben cognossuda per i Ulimpiadi Invernài del 2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: D’invèrn, godèt quai di mejùr pisti de scì del Nòrd America, e d’estaa prùua a fà la mountain bike vèra.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: I permèss i ghàn de vès prenutàà per témp. Te ghé de vèch un permèss per passà la nòcc a Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena l’è l’ünega staziùn di ranger che oltra al campégg la ofrìss alògi dént un dormitòri e pàst còldi. La Leona, San Pedrillo e Los Patos i ofressén dumò campégg e mia servìzi de ristoraziùn.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: L’è pusìbil otegnì i permèss del pàrch per via dirèta da la staziùn di ranger a Puerto Jiménez, ma i ciapén mia i càrt de credit
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: L’asisténza del pàrch (MINAE) la dà mia de permèss püssé de un més prìma del rivà prevìst.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol ‘l ofrìss un servìzi de prenutaziùn per un prèzi de US$30 o $10 per un permèss giurnaliér; majùr infurmaziùn sü la lùr pagìna de Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: I Isùli Cook ienn un staa insülar in libéra associaziùn cunt la Növa Zelànda, chi se truuen in Polinesia, in del mèzz de l’Ucean Pacifich Meridiunàl.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: L’è un arcipelag cunt 15 isùli spantegaa sü püssé de 2.2 miliùn de km2 de ucean.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Cunt l’istess füüs urari di Hawaii, i isùli ienn ognitant cunsideraa cuma “i Hawaii de la Növa Zelànda”.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Anca se püssé pinìn, i me fan vegnì in mént en quai visitaduu anziàn di Hawaii, prima che i deventassén un staa, senza i grànd hotel türistèg e olter svilùpp.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: I Isùli Cook i ghàn mia de cità ma ienn fà de 15 isùli divérsi. I principài ienn Rarotonga e Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Incö, in di paés svilüpaa, furnì bed and breakfast de lüsso l’è diventaa üna sòrta de fùrma d’art.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: In de la fàscia vòlta, i B&B ienn in cumpetiziùn principalmént sü dù ròpp: biancaria da lécc e colaziùn.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Per 'sta reson, in di meiùr strütür de ‘sto genér l’è facìl truuà la biancaria da lécc püssé lüssuosa, forsì üna preponta fàda a màn o un lécc antìch.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: La colaziùn la pò vèch dént buntà stagionài de la regiùn o la specialitaa del padrùn de cà.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: L’ambiént el pò vèss un edifìzzi antìch cunt mubilia antìga, giardìn ben cüraa e üna pissina.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Salì ne la tò machìna e partì per un viàgg lung el ghà üna pròpia belèza in de la sò semplicità.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: A diferénza di mèzz püss grànd, l’è pusìbil che te ghè giumò famejarità cunt el guidà la tò machìna e te cugnusét i sò lìmit.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Muntà üna tenda sü üna prupietà privàda o in üna cità de ogni dimensiùn el pò facilmént atirà atenziùn mia desideraa.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: In pòch paròll, doperà la machìna l’è üna bùna manéra de fà un viàgg on the road, ma de ràr l’è üna manéra per “fà campégg”.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: El campégg cun la machìna l’è pusìbil se te ghé un grànd minivàn, SUV, Sedan o Station Wagon cunt i sentàl che si stravàchén.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Un quai hotel el ghà üna redità de l’età d’òr di feruvì a a vapur e di transatlantìch; prima de la Segùnda Guèra Mundiàl, in tel 19esim e inìzi del 20esim secùl.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Chésti hotel ieren indùa i alugiàvén i sciùr e i persùnn famùs del témp, e despèss i ghaveven cüsina refinàda e movìda.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: I fàn pàrt del lùr caràter anca i strütür a la mòda végia, el vèch mia i ültim còmfort e ìl vès invegià cunt una cèrta gràzia.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: De solìt ienn de prupietà privàda, ma a volte i ospiten capp di staa e olter uficiài in visìta.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Un viagiaduu pién de danéé el pudarés cunsiderà un vùl inturn al mùnd, spartì in sogiòrni in parécc de chésti hotel.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Un canal de scambi de ospitalità l’è ün’organizaziùn che la mètt in comunicaziùn i viagiaduu cunt i locài in di cità che i visiteràn.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Per intra a fà part de un canal cuma quést de solìt te ghè dumò de riempì un formülari online; anca se un quai canal el dumànda oltri cuntròll.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: La végn pö procürada, sü carta e/o online, üna lìsta di strütür dispunìbil, a volt cunt racumandaziùn e cumént di olter viagiaduu.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: El couchsurfing l’è staa fundàà in genàr 2004 dopu che el prugramadur de compüter Casey Fenton l’era truuà un vùl ecunomich per l’Islànda ma ghera mia de pòst indùa stà.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: L’era inviàà email ai stüdent de l’università locàl e l’era otegnì un gràn numér de ufért de alògi gràtis.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: I ustèll i ofrìssen servìzi principalmént ai giüvin - un client tìpic al ghà süi vent’ann - ma lì te pòdet truuà anca viagiaduu püssé vécc.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: I famej cunt fiolitt i se véden de rar, ma un quai ustèll i ghe permètt de stà in stànzi privaa.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: La cità de Pechin in Cìna la ospiterà i Giög Ulìmpich Invernai del 2022, che la faràn diventà la prìma cità a vèch ospità i Ulimpiadi estìv e anca invernai.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Pechin l’ospiterà i serimòni d'avertüra e de seràda, e i atività sül giàzz al seraa.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Oltri atività de scì i saràn al cumprensòri de scì de Taizicheng a Zhangjiakou, a 220 km (140 mia) circa de Pechin.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: La grànd pàrt di templi i ghàn un festivàl anuàal che el cumincia da novembar e ‘l finìss a la metà de magg, che ‘l varia a segùnda del calendàri anuàal de ogni templi.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: La grànd pàrt di festivàl di templi ienn celebraa cuma pàrt de l’aniversàri del templi o del cumpleànn de la divinità che la presiéd o oltri evènt impurtànti ligaa al templi.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: I festivàl di templi de Kerala ienn parécc interessànt da vedè, cunt üna processiùn üsual de elefànt decuraa, l’urchèstra del templì e oltri festegiamént.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Üna féra mundiàl (comünement ciamàda esposiziùn universàl, o dumò Expo) l’è un grànd festìvàl di àrt e di sciènsi.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: I paés che i partecipén i presénten contenüü artistìc e educatìf in padigliùn naziunài per mustrà questiùn mundiài o la coltüra e la stòria del lùr paés.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: I esposiziùn orticùi internaziunài ienn evént specializaa chi i mùstren alestiment de fiuur, giardìn botànich e tüt quel che riguàrda i piànt.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Anca se in teorìa i pòden vèsseg ogni ann (sempri chi ienn in paés divèrs), in pratéga l’è mia inscì.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Chèsti evént de solìt i düren tra trii e sès més, e i se tégnen sü sìt che ienn mia püssé picùi de 50 ètari.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: I ghèn parécc furmàt de pelìcula che ienn sta doperà in dì ann. La pelìcula stàndard de 35 mm (un negatìf de 36 x 24 mm) l’è de gran lünga la püssé comün.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Se la finìss, la pò vès rimpiazàda assè facilmént, e la ghà üna risoluziùn plü o manc cumparabìl cunt üna DSLR de incö.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Üna quai fotucàmera de furmàt médi a pelìcula la dòpera el furmàt 6 x 6, püssé precisamént un negatìf de 56 x 56.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Chèstu el dà üna risoluziùn quasi quater vòlti quela de un negatìf de 35 mm (3136 mm2 cuntra 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: I animài selvàdeg ienn vun di sugèt püssé difìcil per un fotograf, e ‘l bisògna de üna combinaziùn de fortüna, paziénza, esperiénza e bùn quipagiamént.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: La fotografìa di animài selvàdeg l’è despess dàda per scuntada, ma cuma la fotografìa in generàl, ün’imagìn la vàl püssé de mìla paròll.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: La fotografìa di animài selvàdeg despèss la necèssita de un lùng teleobietìf, anca se ròp cuma un rosc de useiii o üna creatüra pinina i necessìten di oltri obietìf.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Tànti animài esotèc ienn difìcil de truuà, e i pàrch a volti i ghàn règuli sül cuma scatà futugrafii per atività comerciàl.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: I animài selvàdeg pudaressen vès tìmid o agresìv. L’ambiént pudares vès frècc, còlt, o anca ostìl.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: El mùnd el ghà püssé de 5000 lenguagg divèrs, cunt püssé de vìnt chi ghàn 50 miliùn e passa de parlancc.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: I paròll scriit ienn anca despèss püssé facìl de capì rispèt ai paròll parlaa. L’è propi véra per i indirizz, chi despèss ienn dificìl de pronünzia in manéra ciàra.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Parècc naziùn intrég i parlén parfetamént l’inglés, e in amò püssé naziùn te pòdet speciàss üna conossénsa limitada - in manéra speciala tra i giuvin.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Pènsa, si te vöret, a un mancuniàn, un bostonian, un jamaican e vun de Sydney tücc sentaa inturn a un taùl chi ienn dree a cenà dént un resturànt de Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: I se divertissén cunt stòri di lùr cità natài, cuntà sü cunt i lùr acent divèrs e gerg locàl.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Cumprà el mangià al supermercaa l’è de solìt la manéra püssé ecunomica de alimentàss. Senza ocasiùn de cüsinà, te pòdet dumò scernii el mangià giumò prùnt.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: I supermercaa ienn dree a tö semper plü varietà de mangià giumò prùnt. Un quai supermercaa el furnìss anca un furn a micrundi o anca oltri mèzz per scùlda el mangià.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: In un quai paés o tipp de negòzi, ghè almenu un resturànt sül sìt, despèss pütòst infurmal cunt prèzi acessibil.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Fà e pòrtess dree i còpi de la tòa pòlizza e i cuntàtt del tò assicuraduu.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: I ghàn de mustrà l’indirizzi email de l’assicuraduu e i numèr de telefùn internaziunài per cunsei/autorizzaziùn e per fà reclàm.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Tégn ün’oltra copia in de la valìsa e online (invìess ün’email cunt un alegaa, o tègnela in del “cloud”).
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Si te viagét cunt un computer purtatìl o tablet, tégn üna copia in de la memoria o in del dìsc (acessibìl senza internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Dà i copi de la pòlizza/cuntàtt anca ai tò cumpàgn de viàgg e ai parént o amìs a ca che i vören iüta.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: I àlci (cognossuu anca cuma grànd cèrf) ienn mia aggressìv de natüra, ma i se defénden se i sentissen üna minacia.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Quand i persùnn i veden mia i àlci cuma putenzialmént periculùsi, i pudarissen visinàss tròpp e metèss in üna situaziùn ris'ciùsa.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Béf bevàndi alcolech cun moderaziùn. L’alcol el culpìss tücc in manéra divèrsa, e cugnuss i tò limit l’è parécc impurtànt.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: A lùng andà i pusìbil cunseguenzi del béf tròp i pòden vèss dàgn al fidig e anca el diventà guèrcc e ‘l crepà. El pericùl putenziàl al créss quand se consüma alcool fà de sfròs.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: I süperalcolech ilegài pòden vèch dént impürità cuma el metanòl, che ‘l pò fà diventà guèrcc e crepà, anca in picùi quantità.
